_meta.description: Auto-fix repo registry. With 100+ module repos, the allowlist is PATTERN-based, not an enumerated list: a repo is fixable iff its org matches and its name matches an `allow.patterns` entry (and no `allow.deny` entry). `explicit` pins the non-module repos and their kinds. Module repos are discovered live via `gh` (ci/lib/module-registry.ts) and their dependency graph is read from each repo's module.manifest. Org overridable via FIX_REPO_ORG; config path via FIX_REPOS_CONFIG.
_meta.moduleFrontendSubApps: A module repo MAY embed one or more standalone frontend sub-apps on a stack other than its own AngularJS Web/Scripts/ Admin UI (e.g. vc-module-pagebuilder's Vue3 'shell'). Declaring one below does NOT change the repo's `kind` (still `module` for ownership/allowlist) — it only overrides which developer agent + toolchain handles a bug whose RCA anchor falls under `path`. See ci/lib/repo-router.ts resolveOwningSubApp() and .claude/skills/vc-shell-fix/SKILL.md. `stack` is a closed enum (`vue3` only today) — a new stack needs new agent capability, not just a config row. vc-module-pagebuilder's src/VirtoCommerce.PageBuilderModule.Web/Apps/page-builder-designer/ (Angular 21) is deliberately NOT declared: no agent knows it yet, so it correctly falls through to the ordinary module/fullstack-backend route and STOPs at Gate 2.
